question: What is the average ground speed per airline?
sparql:
SELECT ?groupName (AVG(?value) AS ?agg) WHERE {
  ?flight a <http://www.semanticweb.org/ontologies/flight_ontology#Flight> .
  ?flight <http://www.semanticweb.org/ontologies/flight_ontology#hasAirline> ?groupNode .
  ?groupNode <http://www.semanticweb.org/ontologies/flight_ontology#operating_as> ?groupName .
  ?flight <http://www.semanticweb.org/ontologies/flight_ontology#hasFlightEvent> ?event .
  ?event <http://www.semanticweb.org/ontologies/flight_ontology#gspeed> ?value .
} GROUP BY ?groupName ORDER BY DESC(?agg)
